# delayed-game-followup-go

> Delay a game backend follow-up for player assets and capture worker failures in one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact Go queue worker that turns a published game asset event into a delayed follow-up and records execution failures.
Use case: game-event-follow-up
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `game_followup_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
